newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Sr. vp Philip Sanford to resign.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Sr. vp Philip Sanford to resign.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc said Thursday that Philip Sanford, senior vice-president of finance and administration, will resign from the company.
Company representative could not immediately say when Sanford's resignation will become effective.
The company said he is leaving to lead an investor group in the purchase of The Krystal Co, a privately-held restaurant company in Tennessee.

Although Coca-Cola did not immediately name a replacement, it said that Sanford's duties will be assumed by John Alm, senior vice-president and chief financial officer, and Lowry Kline, senior vice-president and general counsel.
